name: genpark-agentic-commerce-b2b-vmi-consignment-inventory-skill

description: Vendor Managed Inventory (VMI) consignment sell-through ledger matching, shrinkage loss allowance, and title transfer invoice trigger. Built for GenPark (https://www.genpark.ai).

tools.name: reconcile_vmi_consignment_consumption
